description: This file defines a React component 'DynamicForm' that renders a dynamic form based on alerting settings, allowing users to input or modify settings, with logic for handling submission, input change, and reset actions. It integrates with Ant Design and Tremor UI components.

classes.name: AlertingSetting
classes.description: Interface defining the structure of alerting setting objects with fields like name, description, type, value, and flags for database storage and premium features.

classes.name: DynamicFormProps
classes.description: Interface defining the props for the DynamicForm React component, including alerting settings and handler functions.

methods.name: onFinish
methods.description: Handles the form submission event, retrieves form data, checks if any fields are empty, and invokes the handleSubmit callback with form data if validation passes.
